Alternative process DARKROOM

Our state of the art alternative process darkroom is equipped for all of your printing needs.

*Penumbra facilities are available to be rented by MEMBERS ONLY.

Not a member? Become one today!

WHAT’S INCLUDED?

  • Ductless Fume hood

  • 3 UV exposure units (x2 flourescent tubes, x1 LED)

  • Contact frames (11x14, 16x20)

  • Brushes, separated by process

  • Measuring tools (scales, thermometers, digital density meter, hydrometer, pipettes and syringes, etc)

  • Crock Pots

  • Electric kettles

  • Handheld steamer

• 2 stainless steal industrial darkroom sinks

  • 1 slop sink

  • Trays, separated by process

  • Beakers and graduated cylinders

  • Heated electric mixer

  • Immersion blender

  • Hot plates

  • Magnetic stirrer

  • Temperature magnetism mixer

RESERVE YOUR SPOT!

  • Rental is for the entire space, but feel free to bring a friend or two to print with!

  • Half Day (any block of 4 hours) and Full Day (8 hours) options

  • To rent the scanner for the full day, please select both 10AM and 2PM slots
If you have any questions about renting our facilities, please reach out to info@penumbrafoundation.org
